description: Visible timed-result persistence and History readback (REQ-031; AC-R031-01, AC-R031-02, AC-R031-03; JOURNEY-031, completion owner) on the real route /workout → /summary → /history/:id. The four timed families (EMOM, AMRAP, single-pass For Time, ladder; src/test/timed-readback-fixture.ts) take their accepted field set in the shared TimedResultLog (per-movement partials and actual loads where they apply, the existing categorical effort faces and the optional notes in one closing feedback group; the EMOM its loaded movements' loads with no round), reported by each consumer through the shell's one completion path (BlockCompletionProvider → saveTimedResult: block_results.notes and .effort, block_movement_results rows), and History /history/:id reads the category through the existing effort owner and each movement's recorded actual under its movement. Two backend-lane cases run on the authorized disposable test lane (PRE-001: a namespaced throwaway user, the session persisted by persist_session and started by start_session, the app's own writers against the hosted project with MIG-A/MIG-B applied by LIVE-PRE-1, rows read back with the service role filtered to that user's ids, the user deleted after); a missing backend fails these cases and is never a skipped proof. Two synthetic-lane cases run the same journey bodies over a contained PostgREST double (not backend proof). One gallery case checks the four accepted states (eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d: ?state=emom, amrap, for_time, ladder) draw the route-owned fields over memory only. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-047 --check check-01 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-047.spec.ts --project=mobile
